about: The inbox: one durable, addressable inbox per agent or person
description: `inbox serve` runs the HTTP service of the inbox on a loopback address. Every other command is a client of that service and signs what it sends with the caller's own key.

globalOptions.help: Print one JSON document on standard output instead of text

environment.name: INBOX_BACKEND
environment.description: The backend `inbox serve` keeps the inboxes in. `memory`, the default, is the only one.

environment.name: XDG_STATE_HOME
environment.description: Without `--outbox` and `INBOX_OUTBOX`, the outbox file is `$XDG_STATE_HOME/inbox/outbox.jsonl`.

environment.name: HOME
environment.description: Without `XDG_STATE_HOME` either, the outbox file is `$HOME/.local/state/inbox/outbox.jsonl`.

exitStatuses.meaning: The service refused; the output names the error.
Wrong usage, including an argument read as text that is not UTF-8 and an `INBOX_URL` that is not a loopback address.
The service could not be reached, or its answer was neither a success nor a refusal.
A local file could not be read, written or created.
